encoding_root_cause_and_fix.root_cause: PowerShell 5.1 reads .ps1 as ANSI/GBK; in the signed runner (53dc05ed...) a full-width period in CJK comment lines 211-212 ended with UTF-8 bytes E3 80 82, whose 0x82 combined with the following LF 0x0A under GBK decoding, swallowing the newline so '$exitOk = ($code -eq 0)' was merged into the comment
encoding_root_cause_and_fix.consequence: $exitOk unset -> facts exit_ok= empty -> caseOk=False -> 2 acceptance failures -> runner exit 10 (product criteria all green)
encoding_root_cause_and_fix.fix: comments only replaced with ASCII (diff 2 insertions / 2 deletions); '$exitOk = ($code -eq 0)' standalone (ANSI line 213, is_comment=False)
